addition.item: Initial public release of DevArt FAQ for Joomla 6.
Added mixed FAQ builder with support for Joomla Articles and Custom FAQ items.
Added native Joomla article picker integration.
Added responsive FAQ accordion frontend layout.
Added optional Read More links for truncated article answers.
Added color presets and custom color controls.
Added administrator header banner and DevArt branding footer.
Added Disclaimer / Limitation of Liability section in module settings.

change.item: Built specifically for Joomla 6+ and PHP 8.2+ without legacy compatibility layers.
Implemented lightweight accordion behavior using native JavaScript without jQuery.
Improved frontend CSS isolation using scoped DevArt FAQ classes.
Improved mobile rendering and text wrapping behavior.
Improved administrator usability for large FAQ collections.
Prepared extension package for GitHub-based update delivery.
Optimized module structure for stability and JED compatibility.

security.item: Added Joomla entry point protection across all PHP files.
Added safe output escaping and filtered FAQ rendering.
No external JavaScript libraries or remote dependencies used.
No unsafe script execution or eval-based functionality included.
